name: Tow Truck
summary: Tow truck with a tilted boom and hook at the back, side view facing right; for roadside breakdown scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 820 px wide and 460 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cab faces left

author: krakujs
